note: Single-polarity row. TestSFlowV5ConfiguredMaxDatagramBoundsEveryDatagram sets a non-default 600-octet bound on a real Sender, requires every counter datagram for 30 interfaces to be <= 600 octets while together carrying all 30 samples (num_samples summed on the collector socket), requires a flow sample with a 1400-octet header to arrive in <= 600 octets, and requires Sender.Send to refuse 601 octets; the older default-bound unit TestSFlowMultiInterface stays. An encoder bounding by the default instead of the configured size goes red.
